criteria.text: Direct-Mac credentials and connection metadata are scoped by authenticated Rhythm user and host/origin.

criteria.text: Sign-out purges the departing user's direct-Mac credentials, metadata, and background polling state.

criteria.text: Pairing replacement and revocation purge superseded credentials and cached connection state.
